[[2014 Maui Invitational Tournament|Maui Invitational]] champions |bowl= [[2015 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result= Elite Eight }} {{2014–15 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2014–15 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Arizona]] during the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by sixth-year head coach [[Sean Miller]] and played home games at the [[McKale Center]] in [[Tucson, Arizona]] as a member of the [[Pac-12 Conference men's basketball|Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 34–4, 16–2 in Pac-12 play to win their second straight Pac-12 regular season championship title for 14th time. In the Pac-12 Tournament, the Wildcats defeated 8-seed [[2014–15 California Golden Bears men's basketball team|California]]; 73–51 in the quarterfinal game, 4-seed [[2014–15 UCLA Bruins men's basketball team|UCLA]]; 70–64 in the semifinal game, and 2-seed [[2014–15 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team|Oregon]]; 80–52 in the championship game. The Wildcats won their first Pac-12 Tournament title for the fifth time since 2002. As the #2 seed in the West Region [[2015 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], The Arizona Wildcats defeated the #15 seed [[2014–15 Texas Southern Tigers basketball team|Texas Southern]]; 93–72 in the round of 64, #10 seed [[2014–15 Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball team|Ohio State]]; 73–58 in the round of 32, 6-seed [[2014–15 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]]; 68–60 in the Sweet 16, advancing to the Elite 8 for second straight year, losing to 1-seed [[2014–15 Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball team|Wisconsin]] (the rematch from the [[2014 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]'s Elite 8 loss in 1-point overtime last season); 85–78. ==Previous season== {{main|2013–14 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team}} The 2013–14 Arizona Wildcats team finished the season with an overall record of 33–5, and 15–3 in the Pac-12 to win their 13th Pac-12 regular season championship. In the [[2014 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] the Wildcats defeated [[2013–14 Utah Utes men's basketball team|Utah]] and [[2013–14 Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball team|Colorado]] to advanced to the Pac-12 Championship Game, where they lost to [[2013-14 UCLA Bruins men's basketball team|UCLA]]. The team received an at-large bid to the [[2014 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as a 1–seed in the West Region, where they defeated 16-seed [[2013–14 Weber State Wildcats men's basketball team|Weber State]], 8-seed [[2013–14 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]], and 4-seed [[2013–14 San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball team|San Diego State]] to advance to the Elite Eight, where they lost to 2-seed [[2013–14 Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball team|Wisconsin]] in overtime. ==Off Season== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
